# Decks sub-actions

## Deck item set background

Changes the background colour or picture of a deck button.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Item** | The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button. Starts as: `%deckItemName%`. |
| **Color** | A colour as a hex code like #FF0000 or a colour name like red. Leave empty to keep the current colour. |
| **Image URL** | A web link to a picture to use as the background. Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **State** | Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `decks.itemSetBackground`</small>

## Deck item set icon

Changes the little icon on a deck button, for example to show a check mark when something is on.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Item** | The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button. Starts as: `%deckItemName%`. |
| **Color** | The icon's colour, as a hex code like #FFFFFF or a colour name. Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **Icon name** | The name of a free icon from the Iconify website, like mdi:home. Leave empty to keep the current icon. |
| **Icon image URL** | A web link to a picture to use as the icon. If you fill this in, it is used instead of the icon name. Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **State** | Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `decks.itemSetIcon`</small>

## Deck item set state

Switches a deck button to one of its looks, like its normal look or its active look.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Item** | The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button. Starts as: `%deckItemName%`. |
| **State** | The look to show: 0 is normal, 1 is the active look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `decks.itemSetState`</small>

## Deck item set title

Changes the text on a deck button.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Item** | The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button. Starts as: `%deckItemName%`. |
| **Title** | The words to show on the button. You can use %variables%. Leave empty to clear the text. |
| **Color** | The text colour, as a hex code like #FFFFFF or a colour name. Leave empty to keep the current one. |
| **State** | Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `decks.itemSetTitle`</small>

## Deck item set value

Shows a small value in the corner of a deck button, like a counter or a score.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Item** | The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button. Starts as: `%deckItemName%`. |
| **Value** | The text or number to show in the corner. You can use %variables%. Leave empty to hide it. |
| **State** | Which look of the button to change: 0 is its normal look, 1 is its second (active) look. A button can have more looks; use their numbers. Starts as: `0`. |

<small>Type id: `decks.itemSetValue`</small>

## Deck item toggle state

Flips a deck button between its normal look and its active look, like a light switch.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Item** | The button's name as you set it on the Decks page. The default %deckItemName% means the button that was just pressed, which works when this action was started by a deck button. Starts as: `%deckItemName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%deckItemState%` | The button's look now: 0 normal, 1 active |

<small>Type id: `decks.itemToggleState`</small>

## Deck notify

Shows a small pop-up message on every screen where the deck is open. Handy to tell someone on your phone that something happened.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Title** | The bold first line of the message. |
| **Description** | The text under the title. |

<small>Type id: `decks.notify`</small>

## Deck page next

Shows the next page of a deck. After the last page it goes back to the first.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%deckPageNumber%` | The page now showing, counting from 1 |

<small>Type id: `decks.pageNext`</small>

## Deck page previous

Shows the previous page of a deck. From the first page it goes to the last.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%deckPageNumber%` | The page now showing, counting from 1 |

<small>Type id: `decks.pagePrevious`</small>

## Deck page set

Shows a chosen page of a deck.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | The name of your deck (the panel of buttons), as you named it on the Decks page. Required. |
| **Page number** | The page number, where 1 is the first page. A number that is too big shows the last page. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%deckPageNumber%` | The page now showing, counting from 1 |

<small>Type id: `decks.pageSet`</small>
